strengths.why: Once latched it is hard to hit and stays on until a shake-off, repair or EMP removes it; every hit the team lands builds toward the brittle window.
The hover frame reaches vehicles quickly and slips away again.

weaknesses.why: It has to touch the vehicle, so it is exposed on the way in.
A light frame: once its charged shield is gone, one burst ends it.

countered_by.why: Sustained fire stops it before it reaches the hull.
A repair beam pulls it off the host.
EMP drops its shield and knocks it off.
Nothing on it can reach aircraft, and they can shoot it freely.

counters.why: A ridden vehicle shows up for the whole team, and their focused fire turns it brittle.

counterplay: Shoot it on the way in: it is tiny and lightly protected.
Hold F to shake it off, or drive onto a repair pad.
Break away from the enemy's guns: frost only builds while they hit you.

text.name: Rime Burr
text.pitch: A tiny Allied hover-drone that rides enemy vehicles and frosts them over until your team's fire shatters them.

signature.name: Frost Tag
signature.effect: Latch onto an enemy vehicle: it shows on your team's minimap, and every hit your team lands while you ride adds frost; at full frost you are flung clear and the hull turns brittle for a short window, taking extra damage from every hit. If you leave or are removed before that, the frost melts away.

team_play_hook.text: Ride the tank while your team pours fire into it: every hit adds frost, and at full frost it turns brittle.

how_it_plays.as_user: Skim in fast, pounce on a vehicle and ride it while your team piles on; the more they hit it, the sooner it turns brittle and flings you clear. You can't fire while riding, and leaping off early to chill infantry coming to help lets the frost melt.
how_it_plays.as_target: A pale glint lands on your hull, frost starts creeping across it and the enemy team sees you on their minimap. Hold F to shake it off, drive onto a repair pad, or get out of their fire: frost only builds when they hit you. Shaking it off clears the frost.
how_it_plays.teammates: The ridden vehicle shows on your minimap. Every hit on it adds frost, and heavy hitters cash in on the brittle window; a repair player is the host's best friend.

controls.action: Cryo beam: slows infantry and vehicles (not while latched)

how_it_plays.tells: A pale blue glint on the hull, a frost layer that visibly spreads across the vehicle from above as it fills, a crack-and-flash when it turns brittle, and cracked, glowing ice on the hull for as long as the brittle window lasts.
